## Meta AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

Meta is investing heavily in AI models, recommendation systems, ad automation, creator tools, and business messaging productivity.

## AI Product Launches
- Llama model family: Open model strategy supporting developer and enterprise experimentation
- Meta AI assistant: Consumer assistant integrated across Meta apps
- AI ad tools: Creative generation, targeting, and campaign optimization capabilities

## Productivity Updates
- Business messaging automation across WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram
- Creator tools for content generation, editing, and engagement workflows
- AI-driven feed and recommendation improvements for user engagement

## Enterprise Features
- Developer ecosystem: Model access and APIs for AI experimentation
- Business messaging: Customer engagement workflows through WhatsApp and Messenger
- Advertising automation: Campaign optimization and creative testing at scale
